Name: Lander
Notes: Pre-placed root node; trickle gen; starter storage; uplink

Name: SolarArray
Notes: Flat-pack deploy; yield ~2300 Wh/sol via diurnal curve x DustFactor

Name: BatteryBank
Notes: 1000 W max charge/discharge; ~1 night of baseline per bank

Name: Pylon
Notes: Auto-links nearest node in 80 m; cable mesh auto-laid; coverage disc = territory

Name: ChargePad
Notes: 500 W transfer to docked robot; robots recharge only here; sheds last

Name: Forge
Notes: Milestone structure; batch smelter; sheds first

Name: IceDrill
Notes: Must sit on Ice deposit; 40 kg ice/h

Name: WaterPlant
Notes: Melts ice; 50 ice -> 45 water per h

Name: Electrolyzer
Notes: 10 water -> 8.9 O2 + 1.1 H2 per h; power hog by design

Name: ComputeModule
Notes: Lander upgrade slot; lag 45->20 s; 3.6 kWh/sol -- autonomy has a power price

Name: Habitat
Notes: Dormant M1; Phase 1 exit structure; consumes HabSegment+Shielding

Name: Borer
Notes: M1-d: works bore/carve designations batch by batch; heavy draw, sheds early; burns H2 (1.5 kg/sol-h, whole batch up-front) instead of grid when stocked - and runs through brownouts

Name: AirFilter
Notes: M1-d Gate B: circulates a floor's air - the habitability chain's last link; life support sheds late (priority 8); M2 habitat vision wants these THROUGHOUT
